🎓 How to Use the GTM Strategy Skill

Generate complete launch plans with detailed timelines, responsibilities, and risk mitigation.

💬

Trigger Phrases

  • "Plan a product launch for..."
  • "GTM strategy for..."
  • "Launch timeline for..."
  • "Launch readiness checklist"
📝

Sample Prompt

"Create a Tier 1 launch plan for our new AI analytics feature launching March 15. Include timeline, RACI, and risk register."
📊

What You'll Get

  • Bill of Materials — Every asset needed
  • T-Minus Timeline — Week-by-week activities
  • RACI Matrix — Clear ownership
  • Risk Register — Mitigation plans
💡

Pro Tips

  • Specify tier — Tier 1 vs 3 changes scope
  • Include date — Enables realistic timeline
  • Name stakeholders — Get specific RACI
